mapper.insert: insert into ipam_scan_job (scan_scope, trigger_type, network_id, network_name, scan_status, total_count, completed_count, online_count, offline_count, error_count, timeout_ms, interval_ms, concurrency_count, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) values (#{scanScope}, #{triggerType}, #{networkId}, #{networkName}, #{scanStatus}, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, #{timeoutMs}, #{intervalMs}, #{concurrencyCount}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: select j.scan_id, j.scan_scope, j.trigger_type, #{networkId} as network_id, j.network_name, j.scan_status, case when j.scan_scope = 'ALL' then count(r.result_id) else j.total_count end as total_count, case when j.scan_scope = 'ALL' then count(r.result_id) else j.completed_count end as completed_count, case when j.scan_scope = 'ALL' then coalesce(sum(case when r.connectivity_status = 'ONLINE' then 1 else 0 end), 0) else j.online_count end as online_count, case when j.scan_scope = 'ALL' then coalesce(sum(case when r.connectivity_status = 'OFFLINE' then 1 else 0 end), 0) else j.offline_count end as offline_count, case when j.scan_scope = 'ALL' then coalesce(sum(case when r.connectivity_status = 'UNKNOWN' then 1 else 0 end), 0) else j.error_count end as error_count, j.timeout_ms, j.interval_ms, j.concurrency_count, j.started_time, j.finished_time, j.error_message, j.create_by, j.create_time, j.update_by, j.update_time from ipam_scan_job j left join ipam_scan_result r on r.scan_id = j.scan_id and r.network_id = #{networkId} where j.scan_id = ( select max(candidate.scan_id) from ipam_scan_job candidate where candidate.network_id = #{networkId} or ( candidate.scan_scope = 'ALL' and exists ( select 1 from ipam_scan_result candidate_result where candidate_result.scan_id = candidate.scan_id and candidate_result.network_id = #{networkId} ) ) ) group by j.scan_id, j.scan_scope, j.trigger_type, j.network_name, j.scan_status, j.total_count, j.completed_count, j.online_count, j.offline_count, j.error_count, j.timeout_ms, j.interval_ms, j.concurrency_count, j.started_time, j.finished_time, j.error_message, j.create_by, j.create_time, j.update_by, j.update_time
mapper.update: update ipam_scan_lock set owner_token = #{ownerToken}, scan_id = null, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, update_time = #{now} where lock_name = 'GLOBAL' and (owner_token is null or lease_until is null or lease_until < #{now})
update ipam_scan_lock set owner_token = null, scan_id = null, lease_until = null, update_time = #{now} where lock_name = 'GLOBAL' and owner_token = #{ownerToken}
update ipam_scan_lock set owner_token = null, scan_id = null, lease_until = null, update_time = #{now} where lock_name = 'GLOBAL' and lease_until is not null and lease_until < #{now}

update ipam_scan_job set scan_status = 'FAILED', finished_time = #{finishedTime}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, update_by = 'system', update_time = #{finishedTime} where scan_status in ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING') and update_time < #{staleBefore}

update ipam_scan_job set scan_status = 'RUNNING', total_count = #{totalCount}, completed_count = 0, online_count = 0, offline_count = 0, error_count = 0, started_time = #{startedTime}, finished_time = null, error_message = null, update_by = 'system', update_time = #{startedTime} where scan_id = #{scanId} and scan_status = 'QUEUED'

update ipam_scan_job set completed_count = #{completedCount}, online_count = #{onlineCount}, offline_count = #{offlineCount}, error_count = #{errorCount}, update_by = 'system', update_time = #{updateTime} where scan_id = #{scanId} and scan_status = 'RUNNING'

update ipam_scan_job set scan_status = #{scanStatus}, completed_count = #{completedCount}, online_count = #{onlineCount}, offline_count = #{offlineCount}, error_count = #{errorCount}, finished_time = #{finishedTime}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, update_by = 'system', update_time = #{finishedTime} where scan_id = #{scanId}

insert into ipam_scan_result (scan_id, network_id, segment_id, ip_address, ip_value, connectivity_status, response_time_ms, last_scan_time, last_online_time, last_offline_time, error_message, update_time) values
(#{item.scanId}, #{item.networkId}, #{item.segmentId}, #{item.ipAddress}, #{item.ipValue}, #{item.connectivityStatus}, #{item.responseTimeMs}, #{item.lastScanTime}, #{item.lastOnlineTime}, #{item.lastOfflineTime}, #{item.errorMessage}, #{item.lastScanTime})
on duplicate key update scan_id = values(scan_id), network_id = values(network_id), segment_id = values(segment_id), ip_value = values(ip_value), connectivity_status = values(connectivity_status), response_time_ms = values(response_time_ms), last_scan_time = values(last_scan_time), last_online_time = coalesce(values(last_online_time), last_online_time), last_offline_time = coalesce(values(last_offline_time), last_offline_time), error_message = values(error_message), update_time = values(update_time)
mapper.select: select result_id, scan_id, network_id, segment_id, ip_address, ip_value, connectivity_status, response_time_ms, last_scan_time, last_online_time, last_offline_time, error_message from ipam_scan_result where segment_id = #{segmentId} and ip_value between #{startValue} and #{endValue} order by ip_value
